correctness.rationale: Independently checked the rank-three invariant: tuple rank-zero types are exact equality/adjacency diagrams, their one-extension sets give rank-one pair types including z=x,y equality cases, rank-two vertex types collect all pair extensions, and the set of vertex types is equivalent to rank-three sentence type. An independent Python implementation used direct integer adjacency masks to form all four distinct-third-vertex adjacency patterns, unary neighbor/nonneighbor flags, and the full set of pair types. Breadth-first search from K1 with isolated and universal append operations stabilized after exactly 357 distinct signatures, with all 714 outgoing successors matching prior states. The maximal first-reached word length was 16 (17 graph vertices), with exactly two classes and precisely the published order distribution. Crucially, the three-pebble EF composition under an added isolated vertex, and its complement dual for a universal vertex, prove each append is a congruence for rank-three equivalence, so closure of all successors proves the result for creation words of arbitrary length. BFS shortest-path property proves the threshold-graph-only 17 sharpness. Compared against actual verify.py rank-Hintikka recursion and manifest schema/first states; did not treat pre-recorded VERIFY_OK or cutoff enumeration alone as proof.

value.rationale: A complete sharp finite quotient for a classical infinite graph family is a meaningful exact logical invariant. The 357-state closed automaton supplies a finite representative set for testing every rank-three sentence, while its two 17-vertex extremal classes certify minimal kernel size; this is much more than a finite test through order 17, because the closure lemma proves universality. No claim made for rank four, counting logic or arbitrary graph representatives.

final_claim: Nonempty finite threshold graphs have exactly 357 distinct pure adjacency/equality first-order theories up to quantifier rank three. Every equivalence class has a threshold-graph representative with at most 17 vertices, and precisely two classes first occur at 17; the full minimum-order distribution is 1,2,4,6,8,10,16,26,38,48,54,54,44,26,12,6,2 for orders 1 through 17.
